write_device.description: Device node or SCSI address for write operations (e.g., /dev/scd0, 0,2,0, ATAPI:0,0,0)

write_driver.description: CD recorder driver ID (e.g., generic-mmc, plextor, yamaha-cdr10x) with optional colon-separated flags

write_speed.description: Write speed (0 = use maximum supported speed)

write_buffers.description: Number of audio FIFO buffers (each holds ~1 second of audio); minimum is 10

read_device.description: Device node or SCSI address for read operations (used by read-toc, read-cd, copy)

read_driver.description: CD reader driver ID for read operations

read_paranoia_mode.description: Audio extraction error correction mode: 0=none, 1=jitter, 2=check, 3=scratch repair

cddb_server_list.description: List of CDDB servers; supports cddbp and HTTP (including proxy) formats

cddb_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for CDDB HTTP/cddbp connections

cddb_directory.description: Local directory to store fetched CDDB records

tmp_file_dir.description: Directory for temporary audio files (e.g., WAV from MP3 decoding)
